## Review Finding

**[P2] Preserve the `integer` subtype when intersecting with `number`.**

The new `allOf` implementation intersects scalar types using literal name equality. Consequently, a valid schema such as `{"allOf": [{"type": "number"}, {"type": "integer"}]}` produces an empty tuple, even though the intersection is `integer`; JSON Schema integers are also numbers. The same failure occurs when the outer schema declares `number` and an `allOf` member narrows it to `integer`. [organon/src/organon/operation_config.pyL865-L891](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/30aa11b154c3303bffc98e82ae3f23974f72c7d5/organon/src/organon/operation_config.py#L865-L891)

Because an empty result falls through to the default, the parameter is ultimately advertised as `string`. Both generated tool surfaces can therefore reject the integer value required by the schema. The intersection should recognize `integer ∩ number = integer` in either declaration order rather than comparing only identical type names. [organon/src/organon/operation_config.pyL752-L760](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/30aa11b154c3303bffc98e82ae3f23974f72c7d5/organon/src/organon/operation_config.py#L752-L760)

## Checks

* ✅ `uv run --package organon python - <<'PY' ... PY` — reproduced `()` for both `allOf(number, integer)` and `type: number` narrowed by `allOf(integer)`.
* ✅ `uv run --package organon pytest organon/tests/test_operation_config_generator.py organon/tests/test_pydantic_ai_tools.py organon/tests/test_tool_catalog_expanded.py -q` — **141 passed**.
* ✅ `git status --short --branch` — clean review checkout; no code changes were made, so no commit or follow-up PR was created.
